channel.title: AgentShield Security Updates & Changelog

item.title: AgentShield v0.2.1 Released: Multi-Architecture Container Images & PyPI Package

item.title: Advisory GHSA-92f2-4677-rmvh: Environment Secrets Leakage via /proc/self/environ
item.description: Interception mitigation for AI agent /proc/self/environ access and shell variable expansion leak vectors.

item.title: Advisory GHSA-p3v4-5qw2-92rg: CI Secret Gate Self-Neutering via ignoreFiles bypasses

item.title: Advisory GHSA-g5mq-fjr3-39qp: ReDoS Exponential Backtracking in secret regex engines
